svg.title: What it refuses
svg.desc: Things it will not do, each stamped no: pipe a remote script into PowerShell, install a registry cleaner, install a PC optimizer, run a debloat script or a tweak pack, switch off Defender, the firewall or UAC, add an antivirus exclusion because a tool asks, open remote access for a stranger. Each time it gives one sentence on why and the safe built-in alternative.
